participant_id.Description: Person identifier (as in the source, normalized where noted).

session_id.Description: Scan session identifier within the participant.

site.Description: Acquisition site, as coded by the source.

age_group.Description: Age group used by the study (stratification key).

tom_booklet_matched.Description: Theory of Mind battery: proportion correct on 24 matched items (children only).

tom_booklet_matched_nofb.Description: Theory of Mind battery: proportion correct on 18 matched items without the false-belief questions.

fb_composite.Description: Explicit false-belief questions answered correctly, out of 6.

wppsi_bd_raw.Description: WPPSI Block Design raw score (nonverbal IQ, children under 5).

kbit_raw.Description: KBIT-2 nonverbal matrices raw score (children 5 and older).

dccs_summary.Description: Dimensional Change Card Sort summary score, 0-3 (children 3-5).

scanner.Description: Which of the two 3T Siemens Tim Trio scanners at MIT.

coil.Description: 32-channel head coil used (custom child coils for some under-fives).
